name: eqint-savvy-full
description: EQInt Savvy - Full Application Monorepo (Electron Desktop + HCM AI Python Backend)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:desktop && npm run install:python
scripts.install:desktop: cd eqint-savvy-desktop && npm install && cd backend/services/api && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.install:python: cd hcm-ai-agent && python -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev:desktop: cd eqint-savvy-desktop && npm run prestart && npm start

author: EQInt
